reading_rule: Consume each row as a premise or falsifier before proof search. A result implied by a row is dominated; use the stronger row and continue toward the parent theorem. Route choice remains unrestricted.

results.exact_statement: For the scalar q-Apery Pade family with the q-generic seeds L_0 = 0, L_1 = -q(q+2)/(q-1), R_0 = 1, R_1 = -(q^2+q-1), L_j/R_j converges to sum_{n>=1} 1/(q^n - 1) at every rational q > 1 (matched to 57-295 digits over ten bases), and with q = a/b in lowest terms the three-point estimator gives log|R_j| ~ (3/2) log(a/b) j^2, log den(R_j) ~ (3/2) log b . j^2, log|rho_j - rho| ~ -3 log(a/b) j^2, and log|B_j| ~ kappa log a . j^2 with kappa = 3/2 + 3/pi^2 = 1.8039635 DEPENDING ONLY ON a. Hence the linear forms tend to zero iff log b/log a < 1 - kappa/3 = 1/2 - 1/pi^2 = 0.3986788, i.e. a > b^2.50828.
results.hypotheses: Finite exact rational computation to index ~150 over ten bases, with a three-point second-difference estimator that annihilates linear and constant terms; 3/pi^2 is a numerical identification confirmed term by term against phi(j) (correlation 0.98922, slope 0.9905), not a derivation.

results.exact_statement: Under the assumed generic type-I decay, homogenisation, clearing, integrality and nonvanishing model, a rank-r system admits base a/b only if t := log b/log a < (r - 1 - kappa)/r, where kappa is the per-degree cyclotomic clearing rate. At r = 2 with the measured kappa = 2/pi^2 = 0.202642 this is exactly t < 1/2 - 1/pi^2; at kappa = 0 it is t < (r-1)/r. Thresholds: rank 2 gives 0.39868, rank 3 gives 0.59912, rank 4 gives 0.69934, rank 5 gives 0.75947. At t(3/2) = 0.630929753, rank 2 fails even at zero clearing, rank 3 passes iff kappa_3 < 0.10721 (at most 53% of the rank-two rate), and rank 4 passes at the observed rank-two rate with margin 0.06841.
results.hypotheses: Explicitly assumed exponent model: Pade decay (r-1)D, homogenisation cost b^D, clearing cost a^{kappa D}, integrality and nonvanishing. kappa is measured only at rank two; carrying it to r > 2 is a calibration scenario, and kappa = 0 is the rigorous optimistic ceiling with no lower bracket asserted.

results.exact_statement: With rho_j = L_j/R_j, B_j = den(rho_j), D_j = (3/2) j^2: log num(R_j) = (3/2) log 3 . j^2, log den(R_j) = (3/2) log 2 . j^2 and log|R_j| = (3/2) log(3/2) . j^2 with zero drift under the second-difference estimator; gcd(num R_j, num L_j) = 1 exactly at j = 40, 60, 80, 100, 120; and the Casoratian forces log gcd(num R_j, num L_j) <= 2 j log 3 = O(j). Since B_j is a multiple of num(R_j)/gcd and decay needs log B_j < 2 D_j (log a - log b), even a perfect content theorem (C_j = 0) requires D_j log a < 2 D_j (log a - log b), i.e. a > b^2, with D_j cancelling.

results.exact_statement: For the source recurrence y_2 u_{j+1} + y_1 u_j + y_0 u_{j-1} = 0 with a = q^{j-1}, q = 3/2, y_0 = q(a-1)(qa+2), y_2 = (qa-1)(a+2), the Casoratian telescopes: W_j = L_{j+1} R_j - L_j R_{j+1} = -3^{j+1}(3^{j+1} + 2^{j+2}) / (2^{j+1}(3^{j+1} - 2^{j+1})), checked against exact rationals for j <= 46. The remainder is R_j rho_infinity - L_j = -R_j sum_{i>=j} W_i/(R_i R_{i+1}) approximately W_j/R_{j+1}.

results.exact_statement: For every rank N, Zudilin's normalized Hankel determinant V_N* at x = z = 1 has q-order EXACTLY N(N-1)(2N-1)/6 and leading coefficient exactly (N!)^2 (N+1)!/2^N. Lean proves the algebraic assembly: six_mul_zudilinSharpHankelQOrder N : 6 * sum_{j<N} j^2 = N(N-1)(2N-1), and zudilinSharpHankelOrderAndCoeff_algebraicAssembly N : that identity together with 2^N * prod_{j<N} zudilinTransformedRowCoeff j = (N!)^2 (N+1)!.
results.hypotheses: The published source (Zudilin 2016, Res. Number Theory 2, Art. 15, Section 4) proves only ord_q V_N* >= N(N-1)(2N-1)/6. Exactness is verified by exact integer power-series computation for 1 <= N <= 7; the general-N argument is ordinary mathematics whose formalisation covers the first transformed row in every column but not rows j >= 2, and does not identify the power-series determinant with the assembled closed forms.
supersedes: Zudilin 2016 Section 4's inequality ord_q V_N* >= N(N-1)(2N-1)/6

results.why_it_matters: Equality closes the analytic side of the only cubic-decay construction in the corpus, so the entire remaining question there is arithmetic denominator extraction or a different integral model. It is also the corpus's strongest unconditional theorem and the exact quantity any new integral model must beat.

results.exact_statement: (i) Channel divisibility: for every n >= 1, p^{n+1} P_n(p)^3 divides Btilde_n(p) - 2 Ctilde_n(p) in Z[p], where P_n(p) = prod_{1<=r<=n}(p^r - 1); consequently B_n^{(d)} = 2 C_n^{(d)} on every leading cyclotomic layer and the full inhomogeneous source residue is -3 C_n^{(d)}. (ii) Single-channel block formula: for n = qd + s with 0 <= s < d, C_{qd+s}^{(d)} = K_d^{q-1} ((q!)^3 H_q / 12^{q-1}) C_{d+s}^{(d)} with K_d = 12 d^3 M_d(zeta)^3 and M_d = (p^d - 1)/Phi_d. (iii) First-appearance noncancellation: the normalized first d x d cross block is the wrapped Hankel matrix H_{i,j} = a_{i+j mod d} K^{[i+j>=d]}, its determinant is Res(W(x), K x^d - 1) up to sign, and at a prime above 2 with d = 2^a m (m odd, e = 2^{a-1}) the anti-diagonal is the UNIQUE minimum with normalized valuation exactly 3aed; for odd d the analogous minimum has valuation zero. Hence the full first-appearance associated-graded residue is nonzero for every d.
results.hypotheses: Authored all-index mathematics with exact executable regressions (assignment certificates 1 <= d <= 256, subset-DP minima d <= 14, direct resultants d <= 6); not formalised in Lean.

results.exact_statement: For the primitive q-Apery rows at 3/2, the all-index adjacent depths after cancellation of the clearing degrees are v_2 = 3n^2 + 3n + 1 and v_3 = n + 1. Fixing a start s and reducing modulo M_s = 2^{3s^2+3s+1} 3^{s+1}, every later adjacent minor vanishes and every denominator coordinate is a unit; Lean then forces every pairwise tail minor to vanish and produces a nontrivial binary selector collision at width 3s^2 + 5s + 3. Exact identity: gcd_{j>s} det(w_s, w_j) / M_s = gcd_{s<=j<=255} B_j for every 0 <= s <= 15.

A desk that supplies their hypotheses for an actual family has proved the parent at 3/2; the determinant-height tradeoff is simultaneously a MANDATORY falsifier that kills a construction whose coefficient height is too small for its claimed decay.

results.exact_statement: homEval_mod_left: for naturals a, b, W and P in Z[X], homEval(a,b,W,P) mod a = P.coeff 0 * b^W; homEval_mod_right: homEval(a,b,W,P) mod b = P.coeff W * a^W. Hence for coprime a, b a polynomial with unit constant AND unit top coefficient has homogeneous evaluation coprime to a*b, and cyclotomicHomEval_isCoprime_mul gives gcd(Phi_m(a,b), ab) = 1 for every m >= 1. At (3,2), commonMultiplier_not_two_not_three_of_endpoint_units: an integer dividing both H_W(U) and H_W(V), with U of unit top endpoint and V of unit constant endpoint, is divisible by neither 2 nor 3.
results.hypotheses: Coprime coordinates and the stated unit endpoint coefficients. These hold for the q-Apery denominator b_n (degree n(3n+1)/2, constant coefficient 1, leading coefficient (-1)^n) but FAIL for Van Assche's natural diagonal A_n = P_n(p^n|p^{-1}), which has zero constant term and carries a monomial factor p, giving v_3 = 1.
supersedes: any proposal to manufacture 2-primary or 3-primary content at 3/2 from q-factorial or cyclotomic factors
results.why_it_matters: It is the exact statement of why multiplicative q-arithmetic alone cannot help at 3/2: useful content must be additive, cross-row, determinant-specific, or from another architecture. Any new construction must state its normalisation hypothesis explicitly, because the class-wide endpoint claim is FALSE as stated.

results.exact_statement: Descent lemma (unconditional, two lines): H_n = (1/p) H_{floor(n/p)} + sum_{j<=n, p not dividing j} 1/j, so v_p(H_n) >= 1 and n >= p imply v_p(H_{floor(n/p)}) >= 1, making J_p a tree under n -> floor(n/p) with children in [pn, pn+p-1]. Level three is EMPTY for p = 5, so J_5 = {4, 20, 24} exactly; likewise J_3 = {2,7,22} and J_13 = {12,156,168}. Under the all-level monodromy premise (M) R_{j+P_N} = -R_j mod 5^N with P_N = 2 . 5^{N-1}, and its consequence (C5), one gets v_5(B_j) = 1 - v_5(H_{floor(j/2)}) and hence 5 | B_j for EVERY j >= 50.
results.hypotheses: (M) is certified by computation only at N = 1, 2, 3 (periods 2, 10, 50) with zero violations over 300/292/252 indices; its determinant half is a corollary of the Casoratian, and the content is the -1 on the R-line. Verified exactly to index 300: {j in [2,301] : 5 does not divide B_j} = {8,9,40,41,48,49} exactly.

results.exact_statement: The Amdeberhan-Zeilberger denominator is b_n(p) = P_n(p^{n+1} | p^{-1}) where P_n(x|q) = sum_k [n,k]_p [n+k,k]_p p^{-kn + k(k-1)/2} (-x)^k with p = 1/q, verified symbolically for 0 <= n <= 6; Van Assche's own construction uses x = p^n, and Borwein 1992 Lemma 2 uses P_{n-1}(c p^{n+1}|q). But sharing the kernel does NOT mean sharing the recurrence: applying the Amdeberhan-Zeilberger operator L = y_2 N^2 + y_1 N + y_0 to the Van Assche diagonal A_n = P_n(p^n|p^{-1}) leaves the exact nonzero residual -p(p-1)^2(p+1)(p^5 + 2p^4 + 2p^3 + 2p^2 + 2) at n = 0, strictly negative for every real p > 1.
results.hypotheses: Exact symbolic computation with a control confirming the operator annihilates the Amdeberhan-Zeilberger sequence itself at n = 0, 1, 2; one nonzero residual suffices.
supersedes: the working hypothesis that the classical families are one tightly coupled approximant module

results.why_it_matters: It is the exact quantifier fence on every measurement in the corpus: the Casoratian, the v_2 = 3n^2+3n+1 and v_3 = n+1 valuations, the 19n^2/8 clearing exponent and every row-content calculation are q-Apery-diagonal-specific. A desk moving to a new diagonal or a new family must re-measure everything from scratch.

results.exact_statement: h_q(1) = sum_{k>=1} 1/(q^k - 1) is exactly F(t) of Erdos #1049 at t = q. Sections 1.1-1.5 of Amdeberhan-Zeilberger are polynomial identities in q that hold VERBATIM at q = 3/2; section 1.6 is analytic and must be re-established at a rational base; section 1.7 and Lemma 1 are where the integer-base hypothesis enters, through q-product denominator clearing. The section 1.5 recurrence coefficients are y_0(n) = q(alpha_n - 1)(q alpha_n + 2), y_2(n) = (q alpha_n - 1)(alpha_n + 2) with alpha_n = q^{n+1}, replayed symbolically to zero.
results.hypotheses: The authors' own arXiv LaTeX source is authority; an earlier local transcription from rendered page images carried two independent errors (a wrong (q alpha_n - 1) and a constant term q^2 - 4q + 4 instead of q^2 - 4q + 1), each detected only by symbolic replay of the recurrence.

Doron Zeilberger supplied this paper himself as the comparison object in his 2026-08-05 reply.

results.exact_statement: GAP(3/2) = 3 log 2 - (3/2 - 3/pi^2) log 3 = 0.765461 per j^2, which is 38.6% of the height, at EVERY index. Consequently: (1) bounded-rank recombination cannot close it, since a fixed positive proportion of a QUADRATIC quantity is out of reach of any finite-rank operation on the rows; (2) content extraction cannot close it, since the content removed in passing from (L_j,R_j) to the primitive (A_j,B_j) is O(1) with maximum 59 over ten bases and all indices; (3) a single window prime cannot close it, since a window divisor is worth log p = O(s) against a Theta(j^2) deficit.

That is a far more specific demand than 'close the height gap', and it kills the three cheapest families outright. Note also the licensing rule: a growing CLEARED integer form licenses only 'this integerisation fails to produce small linear forms', never 'the approximants fail to converge'.

results.exact_statement: For hpDecay = (1+rho^2)/2 + sigma, hpHeight = (1+rho)^2/2 + sigma(1+rho), hpCyclotomicSaving = 3 sigma^2/pi^2 and hpThreshold the resulting exponent, Lean proves for every rho >= 0 and sigma >= 1 + rho that hpThreshold rho sigma <= 1/2 - 1/pi^2, with equality iff (rho, sigma) = (0,1); and threeHalves_rectangular_hp_gap_gt_threeThirteenths gives 3/13 < log 2/log 3 - hpThreshold rho sigma uniformly on that cone.

results.exact_statement: Scalar row-and-column content is (prod_{i<N} H_i)^2 with H_n = P_n^3/L_n, degree at most N^3 - N; the universally forced primitive residual border factor is prod_{1<=d, 2d<N} Phi_d(p)^{N-2d}, and the combined ceiling is 2N^3 - N. The required charge at 3/2 is more than (39/41)(4N^3 - 3N^2). The valuation-assignment bound is proved SHARP: reversing the first 2d indices and pairing the remaining residues antitonically attains order exactly N - 2d.

results.exact_statement: The actual primitive q-Apery rows at 3/2 begin w_0 = (0,-1), w_1 = (42,11), w_2 = (-88014,-22585). Their first determinant is 42, so every expanding prefix containing w_0 and w_1 has common Plucker depth v_2 <= 1 and v_3 <= 1; the gcd of all three pairwise minors of w_0, w_1, w_2 is exactly 6, and since adding rows only adds minors to this gcd, EVERY later natural-prefix determinantal divisor divides 6.

results.exact_statement: For a stored selector pair (A,B) divisible by its certified modulus M_s, write (A,B) = M_s(A',B'). If F = a/q were rational then q(B'F - A') would be an integer, and noncollinearity ensures at least one of the two normalized forms is nonzero, so BOTH must tend to zero for a contradiction. Exact 30000-bit rational brackets (24000 terms) show both stored normalized selector remainders EXCEED ONE in absolute value at every start s = 1, 2, 3, 4, with logarithmic lower bounds growing from about 64 at s = 1 to more than 2600 at s = 4.

results.exact_statement: For normalized input rows with determinant Delta and denominator-coordinate height S = |B_0| + |B_1|, every unimodular recombination of coefficient height H whose two remainders are at most epsilon satisfies |Delta| <= 2 H epsilon S. Exact replay at the four existing starts gives determinant-forced coefficient-height lower bounds with floor base-two logarithms 0, 52, 293, 1873 against observed heights 2, 92, 710, 2260, so most of the 2261-bit start-3 cost is structural. Moreover at a rational target every nonzero integral remainder has size at least 1/q, so proving cofinal decay of the continued-fraction ratio ALREADY proves irrationality.

Evaluating that exact product law through n = 15 gives the first crossing log|Res(d_n,C_n)|/n^2 = 0.776255453400277 against the forced-clearing exponent 0.765461201033283, BEFORE the separate P-Q factor.

results.exact_statement: For EVERY scalar evaluation exponent m >= n, Van Assche's little-q-Legendre coefficient P_n(p^m|p^{-1}) has degree n m + n(n-1)/2 and unit leading coefficient; the target tail forces cyclotomic cutoff M = max(n, m-1) = m + O(1); multiplying by d_M preserves the unit endpoint, so at p = 3/2 the P-coefficient has exact denominator 2^{D+E} with no hidden power-of-two cancellation. Composing with Van Assche's positive Markov-error bounds gives the strictly positive main term (n m + n^2/2) log(4/3) + (3/pi^2) m^2 log 3, omitting only o(n^2) + o(m^2) + O(m+n). This covers fixed, linear, superlinear and irregular outward offsets.

results.exact_statement: Define a coordinatewise corridor (a,b,N,K,Q,D) by a > 0, Q > 0, D > 0, D <= N+K, a^K | Q D, and Q b^{N+K+1} < a^{K+1}. Lean proves coordinatewiseCorridor_implies_pow_lt_linear : b^{N+K+1} < a(N+K), and three_mul_lt_two_pow_succ : 3x < 2^{x+1} for x >= 2, hence threeHalves_no_coordinatewiseCorridor : for all N >= 1 and K >= 1 and all natural Q, D, the tuple (3,2,N,K,Q,D) is NOT a coordinatewise corridor. The exact cleared-tail recurrence is U_{N+1} = r U_N - B c(N+1) s^{N+1}, whose forcing term is at least 2^{N+1} when s >= 2, B >= 1 and c(N+1) >= 1.

results.exact_statement: Building the rank-three type-I system for (1, zeta_q(1), zeta_q(2)) directly, solving p_0 + p_1 f_1 + p_2 f_2 = O(x^{3D+2}) over Q with deg p_i <= D and taking the primitive integer form, gives kappa_3 = 1.388, 1.193, 1.319, 1.338, 1.205, 1.438, 1.541 at D = 3,4,5,6,8,10,12, against a budget of 0.10721: over by a factor of eleven at best AND RISING. The reason is structural: a generic solve makes the coefficients Hankel minors of height e^{D log D}, so kappa_3 ~ log D diverges. The direct finite measurement of the actual Postelmans-Van Assche m = n-1 diagonal at p = 3/2 gives primitive content exactly 1 for every n = 2..10 and a height-rate proxy log(H_n)/(n log 3) of 5.9791, 14.3215, 22.7694, 32.7322, 40.8786, 50.0378, 60.3251, 68.0767, 77.0722.

results.exact_statement: (i) The all-rank Phi_1 layer of the primitive residual Hankel determinant is mu-independent and equals L_N = (-3)^N (prod_{i=1}^{N-1} d_i^2) det_{0<=i,j<N}(m_{i+j}) with m_n = (n!)^3 h_n and d_i = (-1)^i lcm(1..i)/(i!)^3, so no tuning of the Pade parameter mu and no cancellation between the mu channel and the two inhomogeneous channels can create an extra Phi_1. The natural positivity proof FAILS: the canonical Mellin density w(t) = f_3(t)(gamma + (1/3) log t), whose moments are exactly (n!)^3 H_n, is negative for 0 < t < exp(-3 gamma) and positive above, and multiplying by t^2 does not change the sign, so it is not a positive Gram measure. (ii) There is NO finite-dimensional Q(z)-vector space containing L(z) = sum_{n>=1} z^n/(1-z^n) and stable under both z -> z^2 and z -> z^3.
results.hypotheses: (i) The remaining Phi_1 question is the open conditional-positivity problem det_{0<=i,j<N}((i+j)!^3 h_{i+j}) != 0; (ii) is Proposition res:nomahler of the manuscript.
